## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `80e3b2313738f62017df15f47b8c1547e22fb0a9`
Local-runs: none

Inputs read: card #22606 — its body and all 5 comments (6093959588 triage, 6095790862 claim, 6095932568 first os-dev-report, 6095991649 PM ruling, 6096245003 second os-dev-report); PR #22666 — its body, its file list (2 files, +660 −19) and the net diff against `main` at merge base `5fb1746611` (the API diff and the git diff against that base are byte-identical); the head's check-runs, read at 2026-10-10T09:57Z. Nothing built, run or re-run.

### ① Derived judgments

Accept-set changes of the required `Dogfood Regression Gate` (`scripts/check-shard-attestation.mjs`: `judge()`, `--verify`, `scanWorkflow`):

- PASS ⇒ FAIL (right — the card's defect): a single-leg roster (`total` 1) reading `cancelled` with none of its own credentials present, while another leg of the gate has a credential present, whose recorded cause is the job-timeout annotation (`The job has exceeded the maximum execution time`). `legsNeedingCancelCause` names the leg, `judge()` files it in `killedLegs`, the roster falls through to the count, `dogfood-verify-1-of-1` is listed MISSING and the error names the leg and quotes the cause. Run 38021470264's shape.
- PASS ⇒ FAIL (right — ruling 6095991649 item 1, fail closed): the same shape with any OTHER recorded cause — a manual cancel (`The run was canceled by …`), the bare `The operation was canceled.`, no annotation, a notice only. `classifyCancelAnnotations` answers `other`; red, quoting what was recorded.
- PASS ⇒ FAIL (right — fail closed): the same shape with an UNREADABLE cause — no `GITHUB_TOKEN`; an unreadable `GITHUB_REPOSITORY`, `GITHUB_RUN_ID` or `GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT`; a refused or malformed jobs list; more than 1000 jobs in the attempt; no readable display name in the workflow text (an unreadable `ci.yml` at runtime included — the catch leaves `workflowText` empty); the leg absent or listed twice in this attempt's jobs; the leg not `cancelled` in that list; refused or non-array annotations; or no `cancelCauses` entry at all — `judge()` treats a qualifying leg with no entry as `unreadable`, and a caller passing no map gets red (pinned).
- PASS ⇒ PASS (right): the same shape with the recorded supersession annotation (`Canceling since a higher priority waiting request for …`) — #3668's pass, the log now quoting the cause. Run 37984828810's shape. Two contradictory annotations resolve to `timeout`, the red side — right direction.
- PASS ⇒ PASS, unchanged (right): every leg `cancelled` with zero credentials — `legsNeedingCancelCause` returns nothing (no sibling attested), no request is made, and the `else if (attested.length === 0)` branch keeps the #3668 pass. Pinned as a control.
- PASS ⇒ PASS, unchanged (right): a zero-attestation cancelled MATRIX leg beside an attested single leg (run 38038213421's shape) — `total` 3 never qualifies, and a cause handed in for a matrix leg is never read (pinned).
- FAIL ⇒ FAIL, unchanged (right): #16157's partial-attestation red — the `else` branch logs the base's #16157 line and the base's `else if` on a non-empty `missing` pushes the base's error text, word for word; a cause for a matrix leg does not move it (pinned). Re-opening that path is #22653's.
- FAIL ⇒ PASS: none found. Every new branch either adds an error or falls into one of the base's own branches; the `superseded` `continue` lands exactly where the base's `attested.length === 0` `continue` already landed. Right.
- Unchanged paths: `skipped` under #4928, `failure` dominance, foreign and stale credentials, #11998 attempt scoping, and a single leg with no sibling leg (asks nothing, passes as before).

Single-leg path only: `leg.total === 1` is the first filter of `legsNeedingCancelCause`, which `judge()` and `--verify` share, so the question asked of the API and the question the verdict decides are one. Right.

`--verify`: no request and no token on every run but the qualifying shape; exactly two GETs on it (`…/actions/runs/{id}/attempts/{n}/jobs`, then `{check_run_url}/annotations`) under the job's own token; `githubFetchJson` retries once on a 5xx, a 429 or a network failure, never on a 4xx, and no failure string carries the token (pinned). An exception escaping `readCancelCauses` rejects the top-level `await verify()`, which exits non-zero — closed, not green. Right.

Static guard (`scanWorkflow`): any gate counting a single-leg roster beside another leg now owes `actions: read` and `checks: read` (or `read-all`), `GITHUB_TOKEN` in its `--verify` step's env, and a job `name:` the text reader resolves to the parsed YAML name. `test-gate` (one leg, `--leg "test/6:…"`, `OS_AGGREGATOR_MEMBERS: test`) owes none — the triage's measurement, confirmed in `ci.yml` at the head and pinned. `stepsOf` and `invokesScript` are in scope (closures of `scanWorkflow`). Right.

`.github/workflows/ci.yml`: both hunks (base lines 2240 and 2266) sit inside `dogfood-gate` (the job spans 2183–2290 at the head). The job's `permissions` gains `actions: read` and `checks: read` beside `contents: read`; the `Verify dogfood shard results` step's env gains `GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}` (the spelling `lint.yml` already uses); every other added line is a comment. No job or step renamed — `name: Dogfood Regression Gate` and `name: Dogfood Verify CLI` are untouched; `test-gate`, `dogfood` and `dogfood-verify` are untouched. Right.

Public surface: none — root `scripts/` and a workflow; no package source, no export, no spec key.

Gate verdicts on the head, as read at the stamp above. The aggregate is this PR's own CI running the NEW script under the NEW `permissions` block on the ordinary path: `Dogfood Regression Gate` success, with `Dogfood Regression Gate (1/3)`, `(2/3)`, `(3/3)` and `Dogfood Verify CLI` success. `Build Core` success. `Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL)` success. `Governed Surface Queue Guard` success. `Check Changeset` success. `Check PR Size` success. `Console Pin Gate` success. `Build Docs` success. `Type Check · consumer gates`, `Type Check · debt ledger`, `Type Check · source gates` success. The four PR-hygiene checks (issue claim, single-writer path, part-of, branch claim) success. IN PROGRESS, not waited for: `Lint & Repo Gates` (it carries `check:shard-attestation` — the 218-assertion self-test and the static guard — and `check:required-contexts`); `Test Core (1/6)`, with the `Test Core` aggregate not yet reported (2/6 to 6/6 success); `Type Check · workspace`, with `TypeScript Type Check` queued. The seat reads convergence before landing.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` (label present, `Check Changeset` success) matches what the diff publishes: nothing from any released package — root `scripts/check-shard-attestation.mjs` and `.github/workflows/ci.yml` only. Right.

`Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, on the PR body's own second line, as ruling 6095991649 set it: the required gate's accept set narrows (a green becomes a red) and nothing published widens. The arm is the closed-pair spelling the reader takes — `no (widening)` would be malformed, `no (narrowing)` is not — and it is the reason this record exists before the queue (#16157's ruling: a required-check semantics change lands only on a contract-review-tier review). Right. Report 6095932568's open question on `yes` (#16316's precedent) versus `no` was answered by the ruling with `no (narrowing)`, and the PR carries that answer.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Report 6095932568, open_questions[0] (which discriminator): answered by ruling 6095991649 — option C on the single-leg path only. The diff is that and nothing wider: the cause is read for `total === 1` legs beside an attested sibling, #16157 untouched, #3668 untouched, no new gate script, option A and option D not taken. Answered.
- Report 6095932568, open_questions[1] (Clause-②): answered — see ②.
- Report 6096245003, open_questions: none.
- Dev flag, NOT MEASURED — a real job `GITHUB_TOKEN` performing the two reads (the live replays used the container proxy's credentials). Judged on the direction of failure: a 403 or any refusal is `unreadable` ⇒ red naming the status (pinned: `an API refusal is red and quotes the status`), never green. The premise rests on GitHub's own permission ledger (`actions: read` for the attempt jobs list, `checks: read` for annotations), and this PR's own `Dogfood Regression Gate` ran green under the new `permissions` block on the ordinary path. The first live occurrence of the shape measures it; if it reads red on a genuinely superseded run, that is a false red to fix forward, not a false green. Accepted and named.
- Dev flag, NOT MEASURED — a gate-only re-run attempt where `dogfood-verify` itself was not re-run. Judged from the diff: the leg absent from `attempts/{n}/jobs` ⇒ `0 job(s) named` ⇒ `unreadable` ⇒ red; present with its earlier `cancelled` conclusion ⇒ its annotations are read and the cause decides. Both closed. Accepted.
- Dev flags — the live `--verify` replays and the ablation: not re-run here (read-only); judged on structure. The ablation's mutation (`needsCause = new Set()`) makes `needsCause.has()` false for every leg, so the killed leg falls into the base's `else if (attested.length === 0)` pass — exactly the card's false green — coherent with the reported 12 self-test failures and the replay flipping back to exit 0.
- Dev deviation — the branch was not merged with `origin/main` after the gates ran (`main` moved 2 commits, neither file touched): the check-runs above ran on the merge ref, and the merge-base diff equals the API diff. Accepted.
- Dev deviations — the `github/docs` sparse clone left outside the repo, the extra GET reads, `check:pm-dispatch-gates` run twice: outside the diff, nothing to judge.
- Triage's "measure in the same PR": `test-gate` aggregates exactly one leg (`test/6`), so it has no single-leg roster beside a sibling. Confirmed at the head. Answered.
- Triage's pins: (a) a 1/1 leg cancelled beside an attested sibling ⇒ red naming the leg — pinned, with the ruling's refinement that a RECORDED supersession keeps the pass; (b) the every-leg-cancelled control — pinned; (c) the ablation — reported. Battery floors 29, 32 and 13, `SELF_TEST_BATTERY_FLOOR` 16 ⇒ 19, assertions 144 ⇒ 218 per the report; the Lint gate's verdict on them is pending above.
- Residual, outside this ruling and not a finding against the PR: every leg of the gate `cancelled` with zero credentials still passes without a cause read (#3668, untouched by ruling). A run where BOTH `dogfood` and `dogfood-verify` are killed by their own timeouts with nothing superseding it is therefore still green. The dev measured 47 both-cancelled dogfood runs in the 51 h window that pass under every reading and 0 own-timeout instances of the all-shards shape for Test Core. Carrier: #22653, as the seat decides; no card filed from this review.
- Governed surface: none touched (`Governed Surface Queue Guard` success); head repo equals base repo; 679 changed lines. The PR is draft, as the ruling's "review before the queue" requires.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-22606-single-leg-cancel-red`
Reviewed-by: `session_01Q7Fy4uVkvBWgj9CLihdATJ`

**VERDICT: PASS**
